_meta.name: 2OPMD Mobile SpellBook
_meta.purpose: Everything Devin needs to build the 2OPMD React Native prototype for investor demo
_meta.phase: React Native prototype → investor feedback → native apps later

project.name: 2ndOpinionMD-MVP
project.description: HIPAA-forward AI platform for autoimmune disease second-opinion reports. Mobile prototype: timeline intelligence for chronic illness.
project.goal: Something to show potential investors. Validate flows. Native apps after feedback.

prototype_scope_nate.principle: Focus on showing the whole story simply. Don't ship every edge case. For Dylan + Devin.

architecture.host: Use ngrok or tunnel for local dev; production API at 2ndopinionmd.ai
architecture.streaming: SSE via EventSource polyfill or fetch + ReadableStream for React Native
architecture.cors: Backend CORS must allow mobile origin (Expo dev: exp://)

recommended.forms: React Hook Form or simple controlled components

stack.sse_note: React Native has no native EventSource. Use react-native-sse or polyfill with fetch + stream parsing.

rag_streaming.ask_stream: GET /api/rag/ask_stream. Optional param: include_journal_context=1 to append recent journal entries as context for richer answers.

auth.Register: Optional for prototype. Can gate behind feature flag.

main_tabs.Today: Daily check-in. Quick symptom/flare input. Primary home.
main_tabs.Journal: Symptom entries. List + create. Optional voice memo placeholder.
main_tabs.Timeline: Visual timeline of entries. Pattern summary when data exists.
main_tabs.Ask: Clinical Q&A. ASK mode. SSE stream.

optional.Settings: Minimal. Logout. API base override for dev.

daily_loop.description: Core retention flow. User opens app → Today tab → quick check-in → optional journal note.

ask_question.description: Clinical Q&A. Same contract as web ASK mode. When journal entries exist, include as context for richer answers.

components.TodayCheckIn: Primary CTA. Simple input: how are you today? (mild / okay / bad / flare) or numeric. Minimal friction.
components.JournalList: List of journal entries. Pull to refresh. Tap to view.
components.JournalEditor: Create/edit entry. Severity, factors, free text. Submit to /api/journal.
components.TimelineView: Chronological entries. When sufficient data: show pattern summary from flare_report. Fallback when insufficient data: 'Signal building' (Tree-of-Life metaphor — more entries strengthen pattern detection).
components.AskInput: Text input for clinical question. Submit triggers ask_stream. When user has journal entries: pass include_journal_context=1 to improve answer relevance.
components.StreamingAnswer: SSE consumer. Show status + streaming text. Same contract as web.
components.ErrorDisplay: Honest failure. Cause + recovery. No softening.

ux_invariants.from_parent: Same as 2opmd_spellbook.json — no optimistic UI, no fake progress, honest failures, no mode auto-transition.
mobile_additions: Offline: show cached data if any, else honest 'no connection'
Keyboard handling: dismiss on scroll, don't obscure inputs

aesthetic.identity: Clinical, clean. Same philosophy as web: high contrast, no fluff.
aesthetic.theme: Dark preferred (matches web). Support system light/dark.
aesthetic.typography: Readable. Monospace for data/codes, sans for labels.

style_guide.disclaimer: mobile_spec images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. From a different app (How We Feel). Nate chose them for visual aesthetic. Do NOT build to match those screens. Use for colors/typography/component shapes; build 2OPMD flows from spellbook and prototype_scope_nate.
style_guide.provenance: Publicly available content (unlike leaked Guava Figma — not in use). Nate willing to break rules Dylan is not. Dylan treating IP integrity seriously; believes we are in the clear.

components.primary_button: Full-width, pill-shaped, white bg, black text, min height 52px
components.emotion_bubbles: Circular, color-coded by category, organic cluster layout. Larger = selected.
components.progress_indicator: Thin white line, filled segment, X/Y step label
components.bottom_nav: Black bg, outline icons white, active = accent

style_guide.image_reference: mobile_spec/*.jpg — see STYLE_GUIDE.md manifest for screen-to-image mapping

devin_instructions.prototype_scope: See prototype_scope_nate: whole story simply, not every edge case. Must-have onboarding, home, and other modules. Backend/inference/parsing can be mocked — prototype should feel real.
priority_order: 1. Read 2opmd_spellbook.json — shared backend, same API contracts
2. Read prototype_scope_nate — must-have modules, mockable backend
2b. Read mobile_spec/STYLE_GUIDE.md — style reference only; images are from a different app, use for visual inspiration, do NOT build those screens
3. Scaffold React Native app (Expo recommended for speed)
4. Build onboarding: diagnosed vs searching fork, 30-day bad-day map, emotion context, symptoms selection, journaling value screen, save account, optional upload, starting snapshot
5. Build Home: 2-second daily check-in (Today), structured journal, patterns emerging card, advanced analysis
6. Build other: prepare for visit, Day 3 first-pattern moment, premium upsell modal
8. Build Ask tab: input + SSE streaming (when journal entries exist, include context)
9. Wire API base (env var for local vs prod), test against 2OPMD backend
constraints: Do NOT add analytics or tracking
Do NOT use axios — fetch only
SSE: handle reconnection, show partial results

references.design_commandments: mobile_spec/2opmd_design_commandments.md — Nate's design north star; not yet canonical; Dylan reviewing
